definitions.explanation: A three-legged stand used to support cameras, telescopes, or other equipment. Provides stability for photography, videography, and observation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：10434_yakei⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三脚|さんきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A tripod is essential for night photography.

examples.japanese: ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三脚|さんきゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{固定|こてい}した→固定する：19647_koteisuru⟧。
examples.english: I mounted the camera on the tripod.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽量|けいりょう}→軽量：19124_keiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三脚|さんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I take a lightweight tripod when traveling.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{三|さん} (three) + ⟦{脚|きゃく}→脚：30419_kyaku⟧ (leg) — literally 'three legs'. A three-legged stand for steadying a ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧, a telescope, or similar equipment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三脚|さんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up a tripod
- {三脚|さんきゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧: to mount something on a tripod
- {三脚|さんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}む→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧: to fold a tripod down
- ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧{三脚|さんきゃく}: a portable tripod
- ミニ{三脚|さんきゃく}: a mini tripod
- ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧{三脚|さんきゃく}: a phone tripod

RELATED WORDS:
- {一脚|いっきゃく}: a monopod, with a single leg
- {雲台|うんだい}: the tripod head — the swivelling part the camera actually screws onto, bought separately on serious tripods

PRACTICAL NOTE:
Many Japanese tourist sites, museums, and event venues ban tripods because of the space they take and the trip hazard. Watch for signs reading {三脚|さんきゃく}⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ or simply {三脚|さんきゃく}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧.
